name: Aosta Valley

flag.description: A vertical bicolour of black at the hoist and red in the fly.
flag.symbolism: Black and red are the traditional colours of the Aosta Valley.

hook: The Aosta Valley is the plainest flag in Italy: just a black half and a red half side by side.
trivia: It is the smallest and least populous region of Italy, and both Italian and French are official there.
Its capital, Aosta, was founded by the Romans as Augusta Praetoria in 25 BC.
